# JOR Web Fusion: UI & Scientific Validation Archive

> The interactive front-end and visual evidence repository for the James Orion Report (JOR) Framework.

## Core Interface
- [index.html](index.html): Field-entry dashboard for deterministic scoring of Witness (C), Environmental (E), and Physical (P) data.
- [reference.html](reference.html): Technical authority file defining analytic weights and evidentiary rubrics.
- [modelvisuals.html](modelvisuals.html): Comprehensive visual archive of Bayesian model outputs, featuring chronological distributions and stress-test results.

## Key Scientific Visuals (in modelvisuals.html)
- **Ablation Stress Tests:** Measures the "Telemetry Premium" by quantifying the impact of sensor deprivation (e.g., USS Nimitz radar removal).
- **Prior Sensitivity & Convergence:** Tracks how the Posterior responds to varying levels of initial skepticism (0.01 to 0.50).
- **Correlation Matrix (N=50):** Illustrates statistical drivers of NH probability, identifying Physicality (0.86) as the primary influencer.
- **Forest Plots:** Visualizes Posterior Means with 95% Credible Intervals across 50 historical cases (1947–2024).

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework Evolution:** Documentation of the shift from v3.0 (additive scoring) to v3.1 (evidence-conditioned stochastic modeling).
- **Deterministic Triage:** Executes real-time scoring in the browser (JavaScript) without the computational overhead of the PyMC engine.
- **Interoperability:** Serves as the data-collection point for batch processing in the [JOR_PYMC_V3_1](https://github.com/jamesorion6869/JOR_PYMC_V3_1) backend.
